beats.headline: The programme has a name
beats.text: Carl has a hunch that Signet's storyline is a programme of its own. Mordecai's old friend Eklund, a game guide in the nearby town, supplies the name: Vengeance of the Daughter. Its producer is not yet taking Zev's calls. Mordecai's view of such things stands: a team of writers, very protective of their show, and an elite with thick plot armour at the centre of it.

beats.headline: Carl signs on
beats.text: He poisons Grimaldi's vine with his own blood and offers the producers a deal: he will appear on the programme when it moves to the sixth floor, or he heals the vine and their big night is a dud. They take it, and he heals the vine anyway. Then he reads a Wisp Armor spellbook for cover against mind control, accepts a cone of parasitic worms from Apollon the Mighty so he can speak inside Grimaldi's head, and talks him into lifting Signet's banishment.

beats.headline: The contract does not lapse
beats.text: Zev reminds Carl that his agreement with the programme is still in effect. Nothing signed on a floor above stops mattering because he has walked down a flight of stairs.

beats.headline: A third season, if they take it
beats.text: Quasar's second request in the negotiation for the Gate: an emergency licence for the programme to continue past the sixth floor. The kua-tin agree, on the condition that it is kept quiet; one mention out loud and it is negated. It is the equivalent of a third season, and not every secondary program is allowed to send its elites to the ninth floor. It would also give Sensation Entertainment an incentive to keep Carl alive. The producers have not actually agreed to anything. That was a bluff, and they have been unavailable.

beats.headline: Part one: Fort Freedom
beats.text: Signet gathers about seventy in a clearing around an old white tree: six were-warriors and their caterpillar, the ogre, forty bush elves, a talking tortoise, dryads, monkeys and forest creatures, plus Carl and Donut; the last to arrive are a pair of ursine. Then the quest drops. Part one of two. The leaders of the Naiad Confederacy are holed up in the former river palace of the Naiad, now called Fort Freedom. Help Signet assault it and avenge her mother's assassination. The reward is part two, and every survivor of the assault will be 20% more willing to follow Carl's orders.

beats.headline: Part one done, part two named
beats.text: The first act completes. The second arrives as a name: Queen Imogen of the high elves, Signet's half-sister, who will be at the masquerade at the close of this floor. The reward is the run of the high elf castle, thought to hold something that blunts Scolopendra's attack.

beats.headline: The second act closes
beats.text: A boss battle with crawlers, hunters, the queen and a goddess all in the same room. The high elves do not survive it. Imogen goes down, and the second season is complete.

beats.headline: Sold, with a season still owed
beats.text: Quasar warns Carl on arrival that the Dream has bought the programme out and intends to collect on the guaranteed third season.
